## More About SMS Campaigns

## How to Create a Mass SMS Campaign?

Register, upload your customer contacts, write the SMS message text, top up your balance, and start the campaign. Within minutes, the messages will be sent.

## What Payment Methods are Available?

Cash payment at the bank, credit card online, Privat24, non-cash payment to our account details, via EasyPay terminals.

## What Signature Will the Messages Be Sent From?

By default, all messages are sent with the service's common signature. To send messages from your company's name, you need to add a personal sender signature in the Control Panel and wait for its activation by mobile operators.

## How to Disable Message Moderation?

Moderation cannot be disabled for mass SMS campaigns. You can disable moderation for individual SMS messages that are not commercial. To do this, you need to sign a contract and inform the Support Service of your ID in the system, the subject, and examples of SMS that you plan to send.

## What Do the Delivery Statuses in the Delivery Report Mean?

#### SMS Delivery Statuses:

- Sent — the message has been successfully transmitted to the operator and is awaiting delivery to the recipient's phone.
- Not Sent — the message was not sent because the number is blocked in the Stop-list or entered incorrectly.
- In Queue — the message is waiting to be sent and will soon be passed to the operator.
- In Process — the message has been sent, but the delivery status from the operator has not yet been received.
- Delivered — the message has been successfully delivered to the recipient's phone, confirmed by the operator.
- Not Delivered — the message was not delivered because the phone was off, SMS memory was full, or the recipient was roaming.
- Rejected — the number does not exist or is not recognized by the system or SMS center.

## How Many Characters Are in One SMS Text?

In one SMS text, there are 160 Latin characters or 70 Cyrillic characters. If the SMS exceeds this length, it will be split into segments, and each segment will be sent and charged as a separate message.

## What Is Forbidden to Write in SMS Messages?

It is strictly forbidden to send:

- calls to violence or threats;
- political agitation;
- calls to mass gatherings;
- profanity;
- texts that could be considered fraud;
- links to websites containing "adult content";
- advertising of "adult" services;
- offers involving SMS to a short number;
- signing with names of mobile operators or their derivatives.

For more details, refer to the section " SMS Content Requirements" in the service terms.
